search.scope: Existing recurrence service already updates metadata and dates; a value-only operation must avoid changing them.

candidates.reason_not_reused: Full recurrence path mutates unrelated metadata; value-only helper is integrated there.

creations.justification: Separate value-only operation reuses canonical recurrence transaction/service lock and future selection without duplicating full recurrence policy.

search.scope: Existing installments service and canonical recurrence transaction service expose separate contracts.

candidates.reason_not_reused: Legacy flow handles finite manual installments and cannot safely update the unbounded recurrence rule.

creations.justification: Adapter maps recurring future scope to canonical recurrence service and coordinates cancelled rule protection with existing installment flow.

creations.justification: Targeted Chrome helper is imported by existing operational installments visual test without creating a second runner.
